title: TransECG-SSL: Hybrid Self-Supervised Representation Learning for ECG Arrhythmia Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.35378v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-dataset generalisation remains a major challenge for automated electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia classification because of differences in patient populations, acquisition protocols, annotation practices, and class distributions. Learning representations that remain informative across independent datasets could reduce reliance on dataset-specific labelled data. We propose TransECG-SSL, a self-supervised framework for transferable heartbeat representation learning from unlabelled ECG data. A Transformer encoder is pretrained using a hybrid objective combining masked signal reconstruction and contrastive learning, then frozen and evaluated by linear probing under patient-disjoint evaluation. Experiments across three public ECG databases and seven source--target settings show that Hybrid SSL consistently outperforms randomly initialised Transformers and achieves higher balanced accuracy than architecture-matched source-supervised pret

translated_title: TransECG-SSL：用于心电图心律失常分类的混合自监督表示学习
translated_abstract: 跨数据集泛化仍然是自动化心电图（ECG）心律失常分类面临的主要挑战，原因在于患者群体、采集协议、标注惯例和类别分布的差异。学习在独立数据集之间仍能保持有效性的表示，可以减少对特定数据集标注数据的依赖。我们提出了TransECG-SSL，这是一个从无标注ECG数据中学习可迁移心跳表示的自监督框架。该方法使用结合掩码信号重建和对比学习的混合目标对Transformer编码器进行预训练，随后将其冻结，并在患者不相交的评估设置下通过线性探测进行评估。在三个公开ECG数据库和七种源-目标设置上的实验表明，混合自监督学习始终优于随机初始化的Transformer，并且比架构相同的源数据监督预训练取得了更高的平衡准确率。
tldr: 提出TransECG-SSL，一种结合掩码信号重建与对比学习的混合自监督框架，可从无标注ECG数据中学习跨数据集可迁移的心跳表示，在多个公开数据库的跨数据集评估中优于随机初始化和源数据监督预训练的Transformer。
en_tdlr: TransECG-SSL is a hybrid self-supervised framework combining masked signal reconstruction and contrastive learning to learn transferable heartbeat representations from unlabelled ECG data, consistently outperforming randomly initialised and source-supervised Transformers across multiple cross-dataset evaluation settings.
